components.note: 艹 (grass, plants) — flowers and growth: 花, 草, 茶; 荣 (from 榮) is a tree 木 in full bloom: flourishing, honor.
辶 (walk, 走之旁) — movement and roads: 过, 进, 送; 达 is to get through to, to reach.
大 (dà) is only a loose stand-in for the old sound part, so treat it as a rough clue for dá.
示 (show) — an altar, a table for offerings; as the radical 礻 it marks rites and spirits: 神, 礼, 福, 社, 祝.
亻 (person radical, 单人旁) — people and what they do: 你, 他, 位; 伍 is a squad of five people.
五 (wǔ) sounds exactly like 伍 — and means five; also in 吾 wú and 悟 wù.
立 (stand) — a person standing on the ground line. As a radical it appears in 站 stand, 位 seat, 竟; also in 建立 establish.
台 (tái) as a sound part appears in 抬 tái, 胎 tāi, 苔 tái, and also in 治 zhì and 始 shǐ.
女 (woman) — women and relatives: 妈, 姐, 姑; 奶 is milk or a grandmother.
乃 (nǎi) sounds exactly like 奶.
耳 (ear) — a hand 又 taking an ear 耳: in ancient battle a trophy of capture. Seen in 取得 and in 娶 qǔ, 趣 qù, 最 zuì.
彳 (step, left foot) — walking and roads: 行, 往, 很, 得; 待 is to go toward and wait on someone.
寺 (sì) is only a loose sound clue; its family varies: 诗 shī, 持 chí, 特 tè, 等 děng.
十 (ten) — a cross: first a single vertical line, later crossed with a horizontal bar. Seen in 十分, 二十, and in 千.
酋 (wine jar) with a hand 寸 offering it: honoring a guest. 尊 sounds out 遵 zūn (obey) and 樽 zūn (goblet).
扌 (hand radical, 提手旁) — actions by hand: 打, 拉, 抱; 授 is to hand over, to give.
受 (shòu) sounds exactly like 授.
扌 (hand radical, 提手旁) — actions by hand: 打, 拉, 抱; 指 is the finger or to point.
旨 (zhǐ) sounds exactly like 指; also in 脂 zhī.
纟 (thread, simplified 糸) — silk and cord: 红, 线, 组; 纹 is the pattern of threads.
文 (wén) sounds exactly like 纹; also in 蚊 wén.
礻 (altar, spirit — form of 示) — rites and prayer: 神, 礼, 福, 祈; 祝 is to wish.
兄 (older brother) — an opened mouth before the altar: the one who speaks the prayer or blessing.
亻 (person radical, 单人旁) — people and what they do: 你, 他, 位; 偶 first meant a figure or doll, then a pair.
禺 (yú) is a loose sound clue; same part in 遇 yù, 愚 yú, 寓 yù.
衤 (clothing, 衣字旁) — clothes: 衬 shirt, 衫, 裙 skirt, 被 quilt; 裤 is trousers.
库 (kù) sounds exactly like 裤.
亻 (person radical, 单人旁) — people and what they do: 你, 他, 位; 假 is to borrow or fake, a person lending a false front.
叚 (jiǎ) sounds like 假; also in 暇 xiá and 霞 xiá.
衣 (clothing) — clothes and wear: 衬, 被, 袋; 装 is dress, then to pretend or to load.
壮 (zhuàng) is a near sound match for zhuāng; also in 状 zhuàng and 妆 zhuāng.
亻 (person radical, 单人旁) — people and what they do: 你, 他, 位; 侦 is a person who scouts.
贞 (zhēn) sounds exactly like 侦.
扌 (hand radical, 提手旁) — actions by hand: 打, 拉, 推; 探 is to reach out and feel, then to explore.
The right half is a sound part shared with 深 shēn: a loose clue for tàn.
马 (horse) — horses: 骑, 驾, 骄; 验 first meant testing a horse, then any test.
佥 (qiān) gives the -ian rhyme; same part in 险 xiǎn, 检 jiǎn, 脸 liǎn, 签 qiān.
耳 (ear) — hearing and listening: 听, 闻, 聋; 聊 is a chat, with ears open.
卯 (mǎo) is a loose sound clue; same part in 柳 liǔ, 留 liú, 贸 mào.
鬼 (ghost) — spirits and the unseen: 魂, 魅, 愧; 魔 is a demon.
麻 (má) is a near sound match for mó; also in 磨 mó and 摩 mó.
⺼ (flesh, form of 月) — body parts: 脑, 脚, 肚; 脏 is an organ (zàng), and also dirty (zāng).
庄 (zhuāng) is a near sound match for zàng/zāng; also in 装 zhuāng.
矢 (arrow) with a flag 方: a clan or troop gathered under its banner, with arrows at hand.
忄 (heart, 竖心旁) — feelings and mind: 怕, 情, 快; 慢 is a slow, unhurried heart.
曼 (màn) sounds exactly like 慢; also in 漫 màn.
斗 (dipper) — a measuring dipper with a handle; as a radical it marks measuring: 料, 科, 斜. Also read dǒu (a measure) or dòu (to fight).
礻 (altar, spirit — form of 示) — rites and spirits: 神, 礼, 福; 社 was an altar to the earth god 土.
土 (earth) — the earth god worshipped at the altar; hence a community that gathers there: society.
阝 (city, right-side form of 邑) — towns and places: 都, 部, 那, 邮; 邻 is people in the same neighborhood.
令 (lìng) is only a loose stand-in for the sound lín.
王 (king) — three bars for heaven, people and earth joined by a vertical: the ruler who links them. As 玉 jade with its dot dropped it also marks jewels: 球, 玩.
纟 (thread, simplified 糸) — silk and cord: 红, 线, 组; 给 is to supply thread, then to give.
合 (hé) is only a loose sound clue; same part in 答 dá, 拾 shí, 恰 qià.
阝 (mound, left-side form of 阜 hill) — hills and places: 院, 阳, 陆; 陪 is to sit by one's side.
咅 (pōu) is a loose sound clue; same part in 培 péi, 赔 péi, 倍 bèi.
宀 (roof) — houses and shelter: 家, 安, 室; 审 is a hearing held in a hall.
申 (shēn) is a near sound match for shěn; also in 神 shén, 伸 shēn.
囗 (enclosure) — boundaries: 国, 园, 围; 团 is a round group. Its traditional form had 專 as sound, like 转 zhuǎn and 传 chuán.
页 (head, page) — heads and faces: 头, 额 forehead, 题 title, 领 collar; 项 first meant the neck.
工 (gōng) is only a loose sound hint for xiàng.
隹 (short-tailed bird) — birds: 难, 雀, 雄; 集 is birds 隹 gathered on a tree 木: to gather.
目 (eye) — a cap pulled over the eyes: to cover, to push ahead blindly. Used in 冒险 and 感冒.
皿 (dish) — vessels and containers: 盘, 盆, 盖, 益; 血 is a drop 丿 in a bowl: blood.
⺼ (flesh, form of 月) — body parts: 脑, 脚, 肚; here part of the simplified form 胜 for victory.
生 (shēng) is a near sound match for shèng; also in 性 xìng, 姓 xìng.
日 (sun) — sunlight falling on everything: universal, common. 普 also sounds out 谱 pǔ.
卩 (kneeling person) — a hand 爪 pressing on a person 卩: to stamp or press a mark, hence seal and print.
亻 (person radical, 单人旁) — people and what they do: 你, 他, 位; 估 is a trader's guess at value.
古 (gǔ) is a close sound clue; same part in 姑 gū, 枯 kū, 苦 kǔ.
犭 (dog, beast) — animals: 狗, 猫, 狼; 独 first meant a solitary animal, then alone.
The old sound part 蜀 (shǔ) is also in 属 shǔ, 烛 zhú and 触 chù; simplified 独 shows 虫 instead.
艹 (grass, plants) — plants: 花, 草, 茶; 著 first meant to plant or put down, then to write and make known.
者 (zhě) is a loose sound clue for zhù; same part in 煮 zhǔ, 猪 zhū, 都 dū.
专 (zhuān) also gives its sound to 转 zhuǎn, 传 chuán, 砖 zhuān and 团 tuán (traditional 專).
黑 (black) above 土 (earth) — ink made from black soot pressed into a block.
饣 (food, simplified 食) — eating and meals: 饭, 饿, 饱; 馆 is an inn or restaurant, a place that serves food.
官 (guān) sounds exactly like 馆 apart from tone; also in 管 guǎn.
